query: What visit-note signals suggest high urgency?

per_column.name: chief_complaint_category
per_column.rationale: Complaint type (e.g., chest_pain_cardiac vs routine_preventive) is a legitimate clinical predictor of urgency, derivable from the reason for visit and known before triage disposition. Carries strong signal without restating urgency.

per_column.name: symptom_onset_acuity
per_column.rationale: Onset tempo (sudden_acute vs weeks_to_chronic) is a classic pre-outcome feature that plausibly correlates with urgency; it is a property of the presentation, not a restatement of urgency itself.

per_column.name: pain_severity_indicator
per_column.rationale: Reported pain severity is an independent presenting-symptom feature that carries predictive signal for urgency without being a component or function of it.

per_column.name: hemodynamic_instability
per_column.rationale: A vital-sign-based instability flag is a genuine clinical predictor available at presentation. It strongly correlates with high urgency but is a distinct physiological measurement, not a restatement of the urgency label.

per_column.name: organ_system_involved
per_column.rationale: Organ system affected is a presentation attribute that modulates risk (e.g., cardiovascular/neurological vs dermatologic) and provides predictive signal orthogonal to the raw reason text.

per_column.name: visit_type_context
per_column.rationale: Visit context (acute_new_problem, emergency_activation vs well_child_preventive) is knowable at intake and predictive of urgency. Borderline because 'emergency_activation' partially overlaps with an urgent disposition, but overall it is a context feature rather than a direct restatement.

per_column.name: diagnostic_urgency_proxy
per_column.rationale: Workup ordered (stat_imaging, emergent_labs, ecg_monitoring_stat) is decided as a consequence of the clinician's urgency assessment. It is post-triage and effectively a downstream marker of urgency, so it leaks the outcome rather than predicting it from pre-decision signals.

judge.rationale: Six of seven columns are legitimate pre-outcome presentation features (complaint category, onset acuity, pain severity, hemodynamic instability, organ system, visit context) that collectively give a model substantial genuine leverage on urgency beyond the original reason_for_visit free text. One column (diagnostic_urgency_proxy) leaks because ordered workups are downstream of the urgency decision, and visit_type_context is mildly leaky via 'emergency_activation'. The set is coherent and clinically grounded, so predictive utility is high but discounted for the leakage and partial overlap.
